--- name: smartCreatorMakeSuggestionsSkill description: Suggests content ideas (articles, tutorials and so on) the Smart Creator could make from an entity. ---
# Smart Creator Make Suggestions
Suggests content ideas (articles, tutorials and so on) the Smart Creator could make from an entity.
## When to use
- A user opens the Smart Creator chat on an entity.
## How it works
1. Sets up new Smart Creator steps aimed at `playbackentitymoduleid`. 2. Gathers the entity's semantic topics, or up to 5 from its assets. 3. Renders `chat_smartcreator_suggest` with the thinking LLM.
## Inputs
- `entityid`: Source entity id - `entitymoduleid`: Source module id - `playbackentitymoduleid`: Module of the content to create, e.g. entitytutorial
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `entity`, `semantictopics`, `playbackentitymodule`, and the suggestions response
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorMakeSuggestionsSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorMakeSuggestionsSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

# Smart Creator: Process Pending Records
Runs the Smart Creator pipeline for every record waiting to be generated.
## When to use
- Scheduled batch generation of articles or tutorials.
## How it works
1. For each module in the row's `searchtypes`, finds records with `processingstatus=new`. 2. Sets each one as the current entity with fresh Smart Creator steps and runs the children (outline, sections, questions, render). 3. Marks the record `processingstatus=complete`.
## Inputs
None. It does not read any values from the agent context.
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `searchtypes`: Modules to process - `llmprompt`: Prompt template filled in for each record
## Outputs
- Generated content for each pending record, saved as complete
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorProcessPendingSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorProcessPendingSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: smartcreator_findmemory description: Gathers the embedded source documents the Smart Creator should write from. ---
# Smart Creator: Find Memory
Gathers the embedded source documents the Smart Creator should write from.
## When to use
- Before creating an outline.
## How it works
1. Collects the current entity's own embedded documents. 2. Unless `skipcategorysearch` is true, adds embedded records that share the entity's search categories. 3. Stores the ids as the embedded parent ids. Logs an error if there are none.
## Inputs
- `currententity`: The entity being written about - `currententitymodule`: Its module - `skipcategorysearch`: true to use only the entity's own documents
## Outputs
- The embedded parent ids on the Smart Creator steps
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorFindMemoryFilesSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorFindMemoryFilesSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: smartCreatorParseUserPromptSkill description: Turns the user's creation request into structured Smart Creator instructions. ---
# Smart Creator: Parse User Prompt
Turns the user's creation request into structured Smart Creator instructions.
## When to use
- After the user describes what they want created.
## How it works
1. Reads the user message this step replies to and stores it as `creationprompt`. 2. Calls the `smartcreator_parse` structure and loads the result into the Smart Creator steps (title, outline prompt, content prompt).
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `creationprompt` and the parsed Smart Creator instructions
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorParseUserPromptSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorParseUserPromptSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: smartcreator_createoutline description: Drafts a section outline from the source documents. ---
# Smart Creator: Create Outline
Drafts a section outline from the source documents.
## When to use
- After the source documents have been found.
## How it works
1. Sends the outline prompt and the embedded parent ids to the embedding server's `/create_outline`. 2. Strips numbering such as `1.`, `A.` and `IV.` from each section title. 3. Saves them as the proposed sections and runs the children.
## Inputs
- `aismartcreatorsteps`: Smart Creator steps holding the outline prompt and source document ids
## Outputs
- `proposedoutline`
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorCreateOutlineSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorCreateOutlineSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: chatSmartCreatorConfirmationSkill description: Applies the user's feedback to the proposed outline, or creates the content record when the user confirms it. ---
# Smart Creator Confirmation
Applies the user's feedback to the proposed outline, or creates the content record when the user confirms it.
## When to use
- After the outline has been shown to the user.
## How it works
1. Sends the user's reply and the proposed outline to the `smartcreator_confirmoutline` structure. 2. If the outline changed, shows it again (`chat_smartcreator_renderoutline`). 3. Otherwise creates the target record, saves one `componentsection` per heading (intro, body, conclusion), and runs the children.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `aismartcreatorsteps`: Smart Creator steps with the proposed outline - `entityid`: Source entity id - `entitymoduleid`: Source module id
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `changed`, `proposedoutline`, `playbackentity`, `playbackentitymodule`, and new `componentsection` records
## Implementation
- Bean `chatSmartCreatorConfirmationSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ChatSmartCreatorConfirmationSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: smartcreator_createsections description: Writes the content of every confirmed section from the entity's embedded documents. ---
# Smart Creator: Create Sections
Writes the content of every confirmed section from the entity's embedded documents.
## When to use
- After the outline is confirmed.
## How it works
1. For each confirmed section, asks the embedding server's `/query` for content using the section name and the content prompt. 2. Splits the markdown answer into heading and paragraph blocks, adding the section name as a heading if missing. 3. Saves the blocks as `componentcontent` records, in groups of 5.
## Inputs
- `currententity`: The source entity - `currententitymodule`: Its module - `aismartcreatorsteps`: Smart Creator steps with the confirmed sections and content prompt
## Outputs
- New `componentcontent` records
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorMakeSectionsSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorMakeSectionsSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: smartcreator_createquestions description: Creates multiple-choice quiz questions for each section of generated content. ---
# Smart Creator: Create Questions
Creates multiple-choice quiz questions for each section of generated content.
## When to use
- After sections are written, for tutorials that include quizzes.
## How it works
1. For each section of the target record, joins its text components into `contextcontent`. 2. Calls the `smartcreator_questions` structure. Each question needs at least four choices and a valid correct answer. 3. Saves each question as an `entityquestion` and adds an `mcq` component to the section.
## Inputs
- `playbackentitymoduleid`: Module of the generated content - `playbackentityid`: Id of the generated content
## Outputs
- New `entityquestion` records and `mcq` components
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorCreateQuestionsSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorCreateQuestionsSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

# Smart Creator Render Finished Outline
Shows the user the finished outline and a link to the created content.
## When to use
- After the content has been generated.
## How it works
1. Renders `chat_smartcreator_renderfinishedoutline` with the confirmed sections and the target record.
## Inputs
- `aismartcreatorsteps`: Smart Creator steps with the confirmed sections and target record
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `confirmedoutline`, `playbackentity`, `playbackentitymodule`, and the rendered response
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorRenderFinishedOutlineSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorRenderFinishedOutlineSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: smartcreator_renderasset description: Renders the current Smart Creator record to HTML and saves it as an asset. ---
# Smart Creator: Render Html
Renders the current Smart Creator record to HTML and saves it as an asset.
## When to use
- Publishing generated content as a downloadable or shareable HTML file.
## How it works
1. If there is a current entity, renders it to HTML with SmartCreatorPlaybackSkill using `triggersiteroot` as the CDN prefix. 2. Saves the HTML as `<name>.html` in the entity's upload folder, then runs the children.
## Inputs
- `currententity`: The record to render - `currententitymodule`: Its module - `triggersiteroot`: Site root used for links in the HTML
## Outputs
- A new HTML asset linked to the record
## Implementation
- Bean `smartCreatorRenderAssetSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SmartCreatorRenderAssetSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`
